primary_design: Keep June-selected settings and k=8 at all three dates
sensitivity: Vary only k=2..12 independently at each date for the three existing main models, holding their June-selected representation and other clustering parameters fixed
selection_rule: Same all-seed full-coverage joint silhouette/DB rank rule, separately in common features and embedding coordinates; seed ARI, feature silhouette and candidate ID tie-breaks; sector labels excluded
taxonomy_version: v2; reporting amendment after existing results were examined, not retrospectively prespecified
missing_rule: All three dates and estimable channel values required; an absence, sector tie or singleton is not an unflagged observation
joint_rule: Both geometric and sector-divergence flags true, only when both channels are estimable
